universe: Universe: the 500 stocks that are constituents of a broad equity index at the end of month 120, with their monthly history back to month 1 or to the month they joined the index.

columns.month: Month index t (1 = first month of the sample).
columns.book_to_market: Book equity / market equity. Book equity from the latest annual report available at the end of month t; market equity at the end of month t.
columns.gross_prof: Gross profitability: gross profit / total assets, from the latest annual report available at the end of month t.
columns.log_mktcap: Natural log of market capitalization (USD millions) at the end of month t.
columns.asset_growth: Year-over-year growth in total assets, from the latest annual report available at the end of month t.
columns.accruals: Operating accruals / total assets, from the latest annual report available at the end of month t.
columns.idio_vol: Idiosyncratic volatility: annualized standard deviation of daily market-model residual returns over the 60 trading days ending at the end of month t.
columns.leverage: Total debt / total assets, from the latest annual report available at the end of month t.
columns.turnover: Average monthly share turnover (volume / shares outstanding) over the 3 months ending at the end of month t.
columns.rd_intensity: R&D expense / sales, from the latest annual report available at the end of month t.
columns.ret_next: Total stock return over month t+1 (end of month t to end of month t+1), in decimals. This is the prediction target.
